name: Weekly Inverse Volatility Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Backtest a weekly volatility-scaled long-only portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Rebalances every Friday close using inverse volatility weighting (1/σ per asset, normalized to 100%) with a 42-day rolling volatility window. Fully invested at all times.
source:
# Weekly Inverse Volatility Portfolio
# Assets: SPY (equities), TLT (bonds), GLD (gold), DBC (commodities)
#
# RULES:
# - Signal: 42-day (8-week) rolling annualized close-to-close volatility
# - Weighting: Inverse volatility (1/σ), normalized to sum to 100%
# - Rebalancing: Every Friday close (~52x/year)
# - Direction: Long-only, fully invested at all times

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Volatility Signal ---
# 42-day annualized historical volatility (close-to-close std dev × √252)
# volatility() expects price levels directly — do NOT pre-compute returns
vol_42d = volatility(period=42)(close)

# --- Cross-Sectional Inverse Volatility Weights ---
# inv_vol_weight computes w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j) across all assets
# Output: weight per asset in [0, 1], sums to 1.0 across all 4 assets
inv_vol_weights = inv_vol_weight()(vol_42d)

# --- Rebalance Trigger: Every Friday ---
# day_of_week fires True on every Friday (Weekday.Friday)
is_friday = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Friday)

# --- Always Invested Signal ---
# Long-only, fully invested from the first bar — never exit
# hold_until latches ON at bar 1 and stays on indefinitely
always_long = True

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: no short_entry wired (E18 directional wiring)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=always_long)

# Position sizing: inv_vol weight × 100 = % of equity per asset
# rebalance_on=is_friday: weights only recalculate on Friday close
# Between Fridays, positions are held at last Friday's weights
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(
    size=inv_vol_weights * 100,
    rebalance_on=is_friday
)
